name: obsidian-scribe-plugin
description: An Obsidian plugin for recording voice notes, transcribing the audio, and summarizing the text - All in one

scripts.build: tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production && node scripts/checkMobileSafe.mjs
scripts.build:prod: tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production && node scripts/checkMobileSafe.mjs
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
scripts.update-all-deps: npm outdated | awk 'NR>1 {print $1"@"$4}' | xargs npm install

author: Mike Alicea
